output.headline: TPG Capital brings $303.0 billion of assets and an upper-quartile pricing record to a $200M Midwest target, but has no open platform.
output.differentiator: Its 15.7x median multiple paid sits above the 15.3x upper quartile of comparable deals, so it has a record of paying where this target's margin supports. Peer lines were not provided. [T:record, V:comps]
output.why_them: Deep-pocketed sponsor with provider record; pays 15.7x median

acquirer_overview.title: A large sponsor with a steady, mostly control-oriented record
points: Financial sponsor with $303.0 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2025 (TPG Inc.) [P:1]
18 deals from 2016 to 2023, of which 15 closed (83%); 17 of 18 were control deals [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]
Home sub-sector is Health Insurance; 9 of 18 deals were provider services, and 9 were outside provider services [B:buyer, A:angles, T:record]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Adjacent provider experience and a growth motive, but no open platform
points: Growth was a stated motive in 10 of 18 deals, against 41% of all deals in the file, which matches the target's 11.0% growth [M:high_growth, X:target]
One deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; having bought from this kind of seller is a modest factor [T:record, S:own_fit_s]
No open platform in the sub-sector, so the target would be a new position rather than an add-on; buying in this or a neighbouring region is a slight factor against [A:angles, S:geo_fit]

precedent_activity.title: Relevant deals cluster at $100M-$400M, with one in the target's own sub-sector
points: Quality Medical Group, $187M minority investment in 2022, same sub-sector as the target, at 11.2x EV/EBITDA [D:MA-2022-0350]
Granite Dental Network, $203M platform investment in 2021, at 12.2x; Liberty Addiction Treatment, $118M leveraged buyout in 2021, at 8.8x [D:MA-2021-0439, D:MA-2021-0369]
8 of 18 deals fall in the $100M-$400M size band; Metro Medical Associates ($15M, 2018) is its only Midwest deal [K:size_band, D:MA-2018-0415]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, and TPG's record supports paying it
points: 70 comparable deals show 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x at the median and 15.3x at the 75th percentile [V:comps]
The target's 16.8% margin is above the comparable median of 12.9%, which supports the 75th percentile [V:comps]
TPG's median paid is 15.7x. At the ask, IRR is 18.7% against a 20% target, on a $128M equity cheque at 5.0x leverage [V:comps, V:lbo]
Maximum price is $193M at the same exit multiple and $216M with a platform exit at 15.0x [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal of $88M is under half the $200M EV [C:conviction].
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 of 18 deals fall in the $100M-$400M band, and the biggest deal was $1,388M [K:size_band, T:record].
risk_flags.reality: Capacity exists, but the typical TPG deal is smaller than this target [T:record].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: There is no open platform, so that exit case would have to be built from scratch [A:angles].

risk_flags.title: Thin Midwest and own-sub-sector record
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 deal in the target's region and 1 in its sub-sector [T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 deals in adjacent provider sub-sectors show comfort with the wider provider space [T:record].
risk_flags.reality: Buying in this or a neighbouring region is a slight factor against [S:geo_fit].

conviction.rationale: TPG has 1 deal in the target's sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, but no open platform, and its median deal of $88M is under half the $200M EV. It ranks 9th on the priority list. [C:conviction, R:rank]
